functional.description: Accept POST /v1/messages requests in Anthropic Messages format, authenticated by the existing API key filter.
functional.rationale: Unlocks Claude Code and other Anthropic-format clients against any OpenAI-compatible upstream already configured.
acceptance: Endpoint is registered and guarded by ApiKeyEndpointFilter like /v1/chat/completions
Explicit providerId/modelName routing works on the new endpoint
Comma-separated fallback chains (Story 7.1) work on the new endpoint

functional.description: Translate an inbound Anthropic Messages request into an OpenAI Chat Completions request body.
functional.rationale: Upstream providers only speak OpenAI Chat Completions; translation is what makes the endpoint useful.
acceptance: system field handled in both top-level string and block-array forms
text blocks pass through; image blocks become image_url base64 data URIs
tool_use blocks become tool_calls; tool_result blocks become tool role messages
stop_sequences maps to stop; max_tokens passes through without an invented default
tool_use_id and tool_call_id correspondence preserved exactly

functional.description: Translate a non-streaming OpenAI Chat Completions response into an Anthropic Messages response.
functional.rationale: Client cannot consume an OpenAI-shaped response body.
acceptance: choices[0].message.content becomes a content block array
tool_calls become tool_use blocks
finish_reason maps to stop_reason: stop to end_turn, length to max_tokens, tool_calls to tool_use
prompt_tokens and completion_tokens map to input_tokens and output_tokens
Envelope includes id, type message, role assistant, and model

functional.description: Synthesize an ordered Anthropic SSE event sequence from an OpenAI delta stream.
functional.rationale: The two streaming models do not map one-to-one; this is the core technical risk of the story.
acceptance: Emits message_start, content_block_start, content_block_delta xN, content_block_stop, message_delta, message_stop in order
Each event carries both an SSE event name and a data payload
Incremental OpenAI function.arguments fragments accumulate into input_json_delta under the correct block index
message_delta carries terminal stop_reason and output token count

functional.description: Return upstream errors translated into Anthropic error shape rather than passing through OpenAI error bodies.
functional.rationale: Anthropic clients parse a specific error envelope; an OpenAI error body surfaces as an unhelpful parse failure.
acceptance: Errors returned as type error with nested error.type and error.message
Verified for 400, 401, 429 and 502 upstream statuses

functional.description: Implement POST /v1/messages/count_tokens returning an approximate token count.
functional.rationale: Claude Code calls this endpoint; absent it, the client errors before issuing any completion request.
acceptance: Reuses the Story 8.4 estimator at roughly 4 characters per token
Response is labelled approximate rather than presented as exact

functional.description: Correct or annotate the Anthropic sample entry in providers.example.json.
functional.rationale: The shipped sample points at api.anthropic.com and would be called at /v1/chat/completions with a Bearer header, which cannot work.
acceptance: Sample either removed, corrected, or annotated as requiring translation

nonFunctional.description: Idle RSS remains under 50 MB and peak under 150 MB after the Anthropic schema is added to the AOT JSON context.
Zero new Native AOT trimming warnings; every newly serialized type registered in AppJsonContext.
Existing /v1/chat/completions behavior is unchanged for both streaming and non-streaming requests.
Translation adds negligible latency relative to the existing sub-5ms proxy overhead target.

constraints.description: Native AOT forbids reflection-based serialization; all JSON handling must use the source-generated AppJsonContext or JsonNode.
Only one direction pair is in scope (Anthropic to OpenAI). The reference pivot abstraction serving 13 formats must not be ported.

Two existing SSE defects block this work and must be fixed within the story: the response emits a single newline rather than the double-newline SSE event terminator, and ProxyService.cs:82-83 mutates response state after the body has started.
Reference material is read-only. docs/reff is a vendored copy of 9Router used for pattern extraction, not a dependency to link against.

assumptions.description: The 40 hour estimate was derived from reference LOC, which is a weak proxy for streaming translation effort. A spike is recommended before commitment.
The AOT footprint cost of the Anthropic message schema is unmeasured, yet NFR-1 asserts a 50 MB idle ceiling.
Thinking blocks, modality negotiation and prefetch concerns from the reference are assumed unnecessary for a single Anthropic to OpenAI pair.
Story 8.4 lands first, making its token estimator available to FR-6. If not, FR-6 needs its own estimator.

domainModel.description: Inbound Messages payload: model, messages, system, max_tokens, stop_sequences, tools, stream.
Anthropic content unit: text, image, tool_use or tool_result.
Outbound Messages payload: id, type, role, model, content blocks, stop_reason, usage.
One SSE event in the Anthropic sequence, carrying an event name and a JSON data payload.
Enums for role, block type and finish reason, so mappings are never expressed as inline string literals.
relationships: used by request, response and stream translators

interactions.description: Anthropic client posts to /v1/messages, router translates, calls upstream, translates the response back.
Same entry, but the OpenAI delta stream is synthesized into an ordered Anthropic event sequence as chunks arrive.
Client posts to /v1/messages/count_tokens and receives an approximate count without any upstream call.

edgeCases.scenario: Upstream returns tool call argument fragments split across many chunks.
edgeCases.handling: Accumulate per block index and emit input_json_delta; never assume one chunk equals one complete argument.

edgeCases.scenario: Stream terminates before message_delta, so stop_reason and output token count are never known.
edgeCases.handling: Emit a terminal message_delta with a best-effort stop_reason so the client is not left waiting.

edgeCases.scenario: Client sends multi-turn history containing tool_use and tool_result pairs.
edgeCases.handling: Preserve tool_use_id to tool_call_id correspondence across all turns; mismatches produce confusing downstream errors.

edgeCases.scenario: Upstream provider returns an OpenAI-shaped error mid-stream.
edgeCases.handling: Translate to Anthropic error shape; do not pass the OpenAI body through.

edgeCases.scenario: Anthropic client rejects the SSE framing because events are single-newline terminated.
edgeCases.handling: Fix the terminator to a double newline as part of CON-3; the Svelte dashboard parser tolerates both.

edgeCases.scenario: system supplied as a block array rather than a string.
edgeCases.handling: Handle both forms; concatenate blocks into a single system role message.

terminology.definition: Routing every conversion through OpenAI as an intermediate format. Used by the reference to serve 13 formats. Explicitly out of scope here.
A translator registered on an exact source-to-target pair, avoiding the lossy double hop of a pivot.
A reference module holding shared cross-format logic such as tool calls, finish reasons or usage mapping.
Anthropic's structured content unit. OpenAI uses a flat string or an array of typed parts instead.
Anthropic's completion terminator field. Corresponds to OpenAI finish_reason with a different value vocabulary.

openQuestions.question: Should a streaming spike run before committing the full 40 hour estimate, as the story itself recommends?
What is the actual AOT binary size and RSS cost of registering the Anthropic message schema?
Is Claude Code the specific target client, or should compatibility be validated against a broader set of Anthropic-format clients?
Should extended thinking blocks be supported later, given that thinkingUnified.js was deliberately excluded from scope?
